claim_label: Heterogeneous AI Impact on Worker Skill
description: AI assistance disproportionately benefits less experienced and lower-skill workers, while having little effect on or slightly decreasing the quality of output for the most skilled workers.

instances.assertion: AI assistance disproportionately benefits less experienced and lower-skill workers, while having little effect on or slightly decreasing the quality of output for the most skilled workers.
Access to AI assistance increases overall worker productivity by 15%, with larger gains for novice and less-skilled workers.
AI assistance significantly improves productivity for less experienced and lower-skilled workers.
